WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: the quarterly overhead budget
First quarter: 213,000 cases × 0.02 = 4,260 machine hours × $50.00 = $213,000 variable, plus $450,000 fixed = $663,000. Figure F307-10 shows every quarter.

EXAM TRAP   Fixed overhead does not follow volume
Budgeting fixed overhead as an amount per case makes it rise and fall with production. In the overhead budget, fixed overhead is the same each quarter; only variable overhead follows the driver.
